comment: ROMtool part roles mapped to ANS-standard parts for the iBwave-style BOM export (GET /projects/{pid}/bom_ibwave.csv and .xlsx) and the assembly builders. Each role names one part: manufacturer, model (MPN), description, iBwave Type, unit (ea or ft). Defaults come from ANS quote history: the part used on the most jobs for the role (ties go to the part that appears first in the history file). Roles with no usable history carry model "" and source "no ANS standard yet"; no part number is invented for them. Remotes and head-end OEM gear stay generic until OEM packages are added. This file holds identifiers and descriptions only.
history_note: Source file: ANS quote history (Mfr, MPN, Description, Category, Jobs columns). Only those columns were read. Descriptions are rewritten in plain text where the history text is garbled. Re-run the job count check when the history changes.
iBwave_type_note: Type strings are ROMtool's labels for iBwave equipment classes. Check them against the iBwave library used by the estimating tool's BOM Import before the first import.
